### Power Point - Sept. 26, 2006
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-sept-26-2006-1428904.html
Passage: Nehemiah 6:15
Points:
- Under Nehemiah's leadership, what seemed impossible was completed in just fifty-two days.
- The completion was so clearly supernatural that even the enemies recognized God was behind it.
- Believers should desire to take part in works that cannot be explained apart from God.
- When kingdom work is empowered by the Holy Spirit, Jesus Christ receives all the glory.
- God invites His people to pray for the Spirit's filling and be used for great things.
